summary: Phase 4b Replenishment→Draft PO conversion tested end-to-end. All 8 pytest cases and all frontend Playwright assertions passed. Backend correctly (a) scopes list to partner, (b) resolves primary supplier by same-country/lowest-cost tiebreak, (c) groups by supplier producing 1 draft PO with 2 lines for SUP-CI-0001, (d) skips no-supplier row (rep_002) with reason 'no_supplier', (e) enforces idempotency (reason='already_converted' + detail.po_status='draft'), (f) allows recycling after cancel — new PO created, (g) 401 without bearer, (h) cross-partner suggestion → skipped 'not_found'. Frontend: restock-page renders, bucket counts (3→1 converting 2), no-supplier badge + disabled checkbox on rep_002, select-all picks only 2 convertible items, confirm modal shows '1 draft PO(s) from your 2 selected suggestion(s)' with SUP-CI-0001 group (13500 XOF), result modal exposes restock-result-po-PO-CI-2026-00001, PO-links appear on the 2 converted rows, To convert bucket drops to 1 & Converted bucket = 2, restock-result-goto navigates to /partner-portal/purchase-orders. State reset before + after test run so seed suggestions remain reusable.
critical_code_review_comments: replenishment_routes.py line 248: `if r.status not in ('suggested', 'converted_to_po')` — allowing 'converted_to_po' here is only safe because the earlier duplicate guard (line 239) has already rejected active links. Works today, but a comment explaining the invariant would help future maintainers.
The status ck constraint change (0015 migration) + ORM enum both need to stay in sync — currently they are. Good.

Recycle-after-cancel creates a NEW PO but the old cancelled PO's audit row still references old po_id; consider whether to also clear converted_po_id on cancel to make the state machine cleaner (currently it's cleared implicitly on re-convert). Minor.
seed_data_creation: None — used pre-seeded rep_test_alpha_001/002/003. State reset before and after test run via DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4b complete. test_replenishment_phase4b.py auto-resets state via asyncpg fixture, safe to re-run. Frontend route: /partner-portal/restock. Seed suggestions rep_test_alpha_001/003 have supplier SUP-CI-0001, rep_test_alpha_002 has no supplier — designed for happy-path + skip-reason coverage.
